bonuses.name: Living Metal
bonuses.text: At the start of each of this Threat’s turns it regains 1 Wound and 1 Shock.

bonuses.name: Nanoscarab Reanimation Protocols
bonuses.text: Whenever a Threat within 6m that shares a [DYNASTY] Keyword with the Canoptek Reanimator activates its Reanimation Protocols, it may roll 2d6.

abilities.name: Self Destruct
abilities.text: When this Threat dies, roll a d6. If you roll a Complication, the threat explodes using the following profile: 12 +5 ED / Blast (10), Rad (1).
